name: Crazy Taxi  - High Roller
desc:
Crazy Taxi 3 serves up more of the classic gameplay that made the series so popular on the Dreamcast. High Roller takes place in "Glitter Oasis" which is modeled after Las Vegas. You take the roll as one of 4 new drivers and you must try to deliver as many customers as possible to collect huge fares.

Crazy Taxi 3 also includes reworked versions of the original 2 levels from Crazy Taxi and Crazy Taxi 2 -- West Coast and Small Apple each with their respective drivers. Also included is Crazy X mode in which you play through a slew of minigames for when you don't feel like tackling the main game.

name: Ghost Squad
desc:
A 1 to 2 player 3-D military combat shooting game with a wide-variety of special features and options.

Per Sega: 'Ghost Global Humanitarian Operation Special Tactics Squad has nothing to do with ghosts as the title may suggest but everything to do with beating terrorism on the world stage, saving world leaders and capturing hostages.

You are a member of Special Forces and fights against very dangerous operations, such as an eradication of terrorism and a rescue of the President.

You'll have an exhilarating experience through this GUN SHOOTING GAME, which reproduces Special Forces' operations with full of reality and a machine gun.'

name: Gundam Battle Operating Simulator
desc:
A mecha battle simulator from Banpresto based on the popular anime Mobile Suit Gundam.

Players control the mobile suit using the two levers. The machine also has a lever which is used for making small jumps, with larger jumps able to be executed by pressing the pedal and moving the joysticks at the same time. The mobile suit has multiple attacks and different weaponry to use. The trigger on the right joystick is for the beam rifle, whilst the thumb button activates the vulcans. The trigger on the left joystick is for the beam saber, with the thumb button used to guard.

name: Ollie King
desc:
Ollie King was produced by Sega in 2004.

A street wise skateboard action racing game set in the modern day urban jungle. Players can race up to 4 other contestants to set the record time for the course. The more stylish the skateboard tricks are preformed then the faster you go. This is the first skateboard game that concentrates more on racing and speed than special tricks.

name: Outrun 2
desc:
OutRun 2 is a Sega Chihiro arcade driving game developed by Sega-AM2 and manufactured by Sega. First released to Japanese and United States arcades in December 2003.

Gameplay is similar to the original OutRun, but with a number of new mechanics; Ridge Racer-style drifting and slipstreaming is the most obvious. A variety of Ferraris were introduced (courtesy of an official Ferrari license), a new set of 15 European-themed routes to drive through were developed, and the classic OutRun music was revisited and joined by new songs. A new "Heart Attack" mode was added where you have to fulfill various small challenges as you drive.

name: Outrun 2 Special Tours
desc: OutRun 2 SP is an arcade-exclusive sequel to OutRun 2. It features a brand-new set of 15 courses, which the player can choose in addition to the original courses, and two new cars: the 250 GTO, a rare Ferrari from the 1960s, and the Dino 246GTS. A new slipstream feature lets players gain speed by driving closely behind other cars.

name: The House Of the Dead 3
desc:
Twenty years after the events of The House of the Dead II, Lisa Rogan and Agent G are desperately searching for Lisa's father, Thomas. Eventually they find themselves at a local corporate office, which is over-run with all kinds of deadly and evil creatures of the afterlife.

It's up to you (or a friend) to blast your way through the evil dead to rescue Lisa's father. Included are multiple gameplay paths (you choose which way to go), the new auto-reloading shotgun, and 2 player support.

name: Virtua Cop 3
desc:
Virtua Cop 3 is a light gun rail shooter and third arcade game in the Virtua Cop series. Set five years after the events from Virtua Cop 2, the crime lords of Virtua city have recovered from their defeat five years ago. It is once again up to you to rid the streets of Virtua city from crime and assume the role of a Virtua Cop.

The game moves the player's character automatically as he has to gun down criminals and bosses. A new standard weapon is introduced: Guardian II as well as a new weapons changing system. The game has three missions that have their own difficulty: simple, normal and hard. Also new is the ES mode a mode in witch time goes slower to give the player an advantage over the enemies. The game can be played solo or with a friend.

name: Wangan Midnight: Maximum Tune
desc:
Wangan Midnight Maximum Tune is an arcade racing game that expands on the original Wangan Midnight game. Like its predecessor, it focuses on high-speed racing on the Wangan Expressway in Japan. Players can select from a variety of cars and compete in races against AI opponents or other players. The game retains the core elements of street racing, with an emphasis on speed and precision.

The gameplay offers a deep car customization system, allowing players to modify their vehicles with performance upgrades and aesthetic changes. "Wangan Midnight Maximum Tune" also features a story mode based on the manga, where players can follow the narrative through a series of races. Additionally, the game includes multiplayer modes where players can challenge each other in intense races.

name: Wangan Midnight: Maximum Tune 2
desc: Wangan Midnight Maximum Tune 2 (also known as Maximum Tune 2, or simply Maxi 2) is an arcade racing video game developed and published by NAMCO and based on the Wangan Midnight manga. It is the sequel to Wangan Midnight Maximum Tune and a third entry of the Wangan Midnight arcade series and was released in 2005 in both Japan and the United States.
